'''Cioral''' was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the [[Unknown Regions]] [[Chiss Ascendancy]] nation. In [[18 BBY]], it was the stronghold of one of the Ascendancy's [[Great Families]], the [[Xodlak family]]. During that [[Standard year|year]], [[Senior Captain]] [[Irizi'in'daro|Xodlak'in'daro]], [[core name]] "Lakinda," served in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]]'s [[Picket Force Six]] as the [[commanding officer]] of the [[Chiss heavy cruiser]] ''[[Grayshrike]]''. During a [[Battle against Nikardun forces|battle]] against a remnant of the [[Nikardun Destiny]] hegemony, the ''Grayshrike'' was damaged, leaving the final kills to the other [[warship]]s in the picket force—the [[heavy cruiser]] ''[[Springhawk]]'' and the [[Nightdragon man-of-war]] [[Vigilant (Nightdragon man-of-war)|''Vigilant'']]. Although the [[Mission to the Vak Combine|battle]] was a success, Lakinda believed it would not be seen that way on Cioral, as the damages to her [[Starship|ship]] denied her and her family the glory of defeating the enemy.

==Description==
Cioral was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the borders of the [[Chiss Ascendancy]] nation, in the [[Unknown Regions]]. The object was [[Atmosphere|breathable]] for the [[Chiss]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]].<ref name="Greater Good" />

==History==
[[File:ChissAscendancyCanonSymbol.svg|250px|thumb|right|Cioral was an astronomical object located in the Chiss Ascendancy (emblem pictured).]]
In [[18 BBY]]<ref name="GG date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the main events of ''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Greater Good]]'' in [[18 BBY]].</ref> Cioral was the stronghold for the [[Xodlak family]], one of the Ascendancy's Forty [[Great Families]].<ref name="Greater Good" /> In that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="GG date" /> [[Senior Captain]] [[Irizi'in'daro|Xodlak'in'daro]], [[core name]] "Lakinda," an [[Chiss officer|officer]] in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]] [[navy]], served as the [[commanding officer]] of the [[Chiss heavy cruiser]] ''[[Grayshrike]]'' in [[Picket Force Six]]. During a [[Battle against Nikardun forces|battle]] against a remnant of the [[Nikardun Destiny]], the [[heavy cruiser]] was damaged, forcing it to be sidelined while the other [[warship]]s in the picket force—the heavy cruiser ''[[Springhawk]]'' and the [[Nightdragon man-of-war]] [[Vigilant (Nightdragon man-of-war)|''Vigilant'']]—ended the [[Mission to the Vak Combine|battle]]. Although the campaign was a success, Lakinda believed it would be seen as a failure on Cioral by the Xodlak family as the damages to her ship had robbed her, and by extension the family, of the glory of defeating the enemy.<ref name="Greater Good" />

Following the skirmish, the ''Springhawk'' continued on towards its own [[Mission to Rapacc|mission]], but was soon recalled to the Ascendancy's [[capital]] [[planet]] of [[Csilla]] by the nation's ruling body of the [[Chiss Syndicure|Syndicure]]. As the warship was out of communications range, the ''Vigilant''{{'s}} commander, [[Admiral]] [[Ar'alani]], dispatched Lakinda and the ''Grayshrike'' to follow the ''Sprinhawk'' and summon it back to Csilla. While en route to the [[Rapacc system|destination]], Lakinda believed that being taken off the task force to "play messenger" would not be well received by the family on Cioral.<ref name="Greater Good" />

==Inhabitants==
As Cioral was located within the borders of the Chiss Ascendancy, it was home to a number of [[Cheunh]]-[[Language|speaking]] Chiss.<ref name="Greater Good" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Cioral was first mentioned in the [[2021]] novel ''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Greater Good]]'', the second installment in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy|''Ascendancy Trilogy'']].<ref name="Greater Good" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cioral/Legends|Cioral]] was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
